name: Citrus-Marinated Carne Asada Tacos on Soft Corn Tortillas
whyItWorks: Grilled marinated flank steak diced tender and served on double warm soft corn tortillas provides clean, dairy-free iron and protein without greasy deep-frying.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for tacos plain with meat and corn tortillas only. Skip spicy salsa and cilantro-onion relish.
